description: This file defines the ReplicateConfig class for configuring interactions with the Replicate API, including parameter mapping, constructing request URLs, transforming requests and responses, and environment validation. It is part of a larger codebase related to language model integrations and prompt handling.

classes.name: ReplicateConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting parameters and handling API interactions with Replicate models, including request transformation, response parsing, error handling, and environment validation.
